Development environment configuration for the Sails.js application, defining local settings that only apply when running in the development environment.

## Key Components

- **`port`** — Sets the local dev server to port `2024` (avoids conflicts with `fleetctl preview`, which defaults to `1337`)
- **`routes`** — Placeholder object for dev-only routes used to prototype unreleased pages locally

## Usage Example

```javascript
// Add a sandbox route for a page under development
routes: {
  'GET /sandbox/example-query': { view: 'pages/sandbox/example-query' }
}
```

Access the local dev server at `http://localhost:2024` after starting Sails.

## Notes

- This file is loaded automatically by Sails when `NODE_ENV=development`
- Changes here have no effect in staging or production
- See the full config reference at [`flamingo-stack/fleetmdm`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm)
